# Labels

Labels used on issues and PRs. Create or rename them in GitHub under
Issues → Labels; keep this list in sync.

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `type:epic`, `type:story`, `type:task`, `type:bug` | Issue level (set by the issue forms) |
| `epic:E1` … `epic:E9` | Which epic the issue belongs to |
| `hands-on` | Brennan does physical work |
| `decision` | Brennan decides; outcome goes into an ADR |
| `blocked` | Waiting on something outside the issue |
| `dependencies` | Dependabot update |
